profile.headline: Full Stack Software Developer II at Sonepar USA | Southern University and A&M College Alum
profile.summary:
With a solid foundation in computer science from Southern University, my journey continues at City National Bank, where I innovate as an API Developer. My educational background and technical prowess converge, allowing me to excel in computer networking, effective communication, and fostering teamwork.

Bridging business needs with technological solutions, I've honed my skills in full stack development and API strategy.

positions.title: API Developer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Build and manage API proxies on Google Apigee by building CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and deploying to microservices

- Test and debug RESTful APIs using Postman, assisting consumer colleagues with debugging

- Built Azure Info Protection library (C# .NET) that provides sensitivity labels to unstructured files and encrypts non-metadata files

- Documentation of API information along with walkthroughs for many processes/applications for future onboarding

- Proficient in SQL for database management, including complex query optimization and schema design for both relational databases and microservice data models

positions.title: DevOps Intern
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Rewrote python back-end source code to enable a dashboard to leverage the Microsoft Graph API, instead of on-premise databases, to pull Active
Directory data for company dashboard

- Built automated script to transfer automated quarterly reports into an accessible Excel file

- Automated microservice deployment using CI/CD pipelines

- Utilized SQL for database operations including scripting for data migration

- Developed scripts for API monitoring

positions.title: IT Systems Specialist
positions.description:
• Worked in corporate America as a high school student scripting on business administrative software 
• Ensured business needs are met on company SharePoint libraries 
• Self-taught PowerShell for various tasks
• Researched to help solve development problems 
• Developed a function that was implemented into a large program that cut that program’s runtime 
   from 3 days to 10 minutes 
• Recognized in front of entire company along with other developers for contributions
